"""RoboPaint strict trajectory script. Run stages against the live eai-standard service."""
import sys, time, json
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
SHEET_Z = 0.020
MAIN_CENTER = np.array([-0.100, 0.000, SHEET_Z])
PRACTICE_CENTER = np.array([-0.100, -0.1856, SHEET_Z])
INK_CENTER = np.array([-0.105, 0.140, SHEET_Z])

def segment(a, b, max_step=0.004):
    a=np.asarray(a,float); b=np.asarray(b,float)
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/max_step)))
    return np.linspace(a,b,n+1)[1:]

def poses_from_xyz(xyz, q=DOWN):
    return np.asarray([np.r_[p,q] for p in xyz], dtype=np.float32)

def send_path(r, xyz, note, video="mp4", cameras=None):
    res=r.submit("ee_pose", poses_from_xyz(xyz), dt=0.05, video=video,
                 cameras=cameras, note=note)
    print(json.dumps({"note":note,"calls":r.status(),"plan":res.meta.get("plan"),
                      "executed_rows":res.meta.get("executed_rows"),"stopped":res.stopped}))
    return res

def dip(r):
    now=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["scene_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10],float)
    above=INK_CENTER.copy(); above[2]=0.105
    xyz=list(segment(now,above)); xyz.extend(segment(above,INK_CENTER))
    xyz.extend([INK_CENTER.copy() for _ in range(8)])
    xyz.extend(segment(INK_CENTER,above))
    return send_path(r,xyz,"load ink at the visible ink stone",cameras=["scene_cam","side_cam"])

def practice_tests(r):
    # Three unscored pressure samples, on three nearby parallel 45 mm paths.
    # Pixel-free world coordinates are tied to the practice camera mount.
    lines=[]
    for i,z in enumerate([0.016,0.010,0.004]):
        y=PRACTICE_CENTER[1] + (i-1)*0.018
        a=np.array([-0.127,y,z]); b=np.array([-0.073,y,z])
        if i==0:
            start=np.array([-0.100,y,0.090]); lines.extend(segment(np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10]),start))
        else:
            # Lift and translate between tests. Each below-paper segment remains only the intended stroke.
            last=lines[-1]
            up=last.copy(); up[2]=0.090
            lines.extend(segment(last,up)); next_start=np.array([-0.127,y,0.090]); lines.extend(segment(up,next_start))
        lines.extend(segment(np.array([a[0],a[1],0.090]),a))
        lines.extend(segment(a,b))
        lines.extend(segment(b,np.array([b[0],b[1],0.090])))
    return send_path(r,lines,"unscored practice strokes at three press depths",cameras=["practice_cam","side_cam"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r=Robot(); print("initial",r.status())
    stage=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "dip"
    if stage=="dip": dip(r)
    elif stage=="practice": practice_tests(r)
    elif stage=="status": print(json.dumps(r.status()))
